backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the full backend for the Somers Scheduler app, including user profiles, win/loss stats, leaderboard, availability scheduling, chat posts, reactions, daily logs, and badge definitions/awards with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two implemented features—converting ProfileWinLossChart to a bar chart and fixing the best streak calculation on ProfilePage—to their affected files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, hooks, and utilities across the React app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.) used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the Somers Scheduler PWA, including viewport meta tags, PWA manifest link, favicon, iOS home screen icons, and iOS splash screen links for multiple device sizes.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA web app manifest for Somers Scheduler specifying app name, display mode, theme/background colors, orientation, and icon URLs for 192×192 and 512×512 sizes.
frontend/public/offline.html: Static offline fallback page displayed by the service worker when the user has no internet connection, featuring a styled message and a retry button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing install-time precaching, old-cache cleanup on activate, and a network-first fetch strategy with cache fallback for navigation and static assets, skipping IC/identity network requests.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that sets up routing with TanStack Router and an AuthGate wrapper handling Internet Identity authentication, actor initialization, leaderboard setup, and profile loading with error/loading states.
frontend/src/components/admin/BadgeManag: Admin UI component for creating, editing, and deleting badge definitions with a form supporting criteria types (totalWins, winsStreak, totalGames) and a confirmation dialog for deletions.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Simple full-page card component displayed when a non-admin user attempts to access a restricted admin page, with a link back to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login page with a background image, app logo, and a single Internet Identity sign-in button that shows a loading state while authenticating.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple image component that renders the application logo using the URL and alt text from the branding configuration.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Main chat UI card that displays a threaded post list with scroll area, handles new message submission with optional image attachments, and shows upload progress.
frontend/src/components/chat/DeleteMessa: Alert dialog component that prompts the user to confirm permanent deletion of a chat message, with a disabled state during the deletion operation.
frontend/src/components/chat/ImageAttach: File input component for attaching images to chat messages, showing a preview thumbnail with a remove button and validating the selected file before accepting it.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReactionCon: Like/dislike button controls for a chat post that apply optimistic UI updates and revert on error, using add/remove reaction mutations from the query hooks.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReplyCompos: A form component for composing and submitting replies to a parent post, supporting text input and optional image attachments with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/chat/ThreadedPos: Renders a recursive threaded tree of posts with support for inline editing, deletion, reactions, and reply composition, indenting nested replies visually.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: A reusable error alert component that displays a title, message, and optional retry or secondary action buttons.
frontend/src/components/common/LoadingSt: Provides two loading indicator components: a full-page centered spinner and a smaller inline spinner, both with optional messages.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Top-level layout wrapper that composes the offline banner, top bar, navigation, main content area, and footer for the application.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Horizontal navigation bar with links to Calendar, Leaderboard, Profile, and conditionally Admin pages, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageLayou: Utility layout components providing a centered max-width page container and a standardized page header with optional icon and action slot.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Application header displaying the app logo, title, theme toggle, PWA install button, and a user avatar dropdown with logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileB: Displays a grid of earned achievement badges for a given user, fetching badge definitions and user awards, with loading skeletons and an empty state.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Displays and allows editing of the current user's profile card, including name editing and avatar image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Shows the current user's all-time leaderboard rank by finding their principal in the leaderboard data.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Renders the caller's match history as a list of daily win/loss records, with loading skeletons and error handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: A modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name before proceeding, saving the profile on submission.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileW: Renders a bar chart of wins and losses over a selectable time range (week, month, year, all-time) using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallInstr: A dialog providing step-by-step instructions for installing the app to the home screen, with separate flows for iOS and Android.
frontend/src/components/pwa/OfflineBanne: Displays a fixed top banner when the user loses network connectivity, hiding it again when connectivity is restored.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps children in a full-screen container with a faint court image as a fixed background.
Renders a user avatar alongside their display name with configurable size, falling back to initials derived from the principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving the current caller's user profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch the caller's user role and check whether they have admin privileges.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Hook that manages PWA install prompt state, detecting iOS, standalone mode, and exposing a function to trigger the browser's install prompt.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for user profiles, availability, leaderboard, posts, and other app data.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Hook that manages light/dark theme state, persisting the preference to localStorage and toggling the 'dark' class on the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: React Query hooks for fetching display names and avatars for a list of principals, with fallback to truncated principal strings.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind base/components/utilities, CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, and safe-area/layout utilities.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports a centralized BRANDING constant containing the app name, logo URL, and logo alt text for the Somers Scheduler app.
frontend/src/lib/chatThreads.ts: Utility functions to build a nested thread tree from a flat list of posts and flatten it with depth metadata for rendering.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Date utility functions for converting between Date objects and numeric day IDs, generating calendar grids, and formatting dates and timestamps.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Page for adding or editing a user's availability for a specific date, with time (hour/minute/AM-PM) and notes fields, submitting via the addAvailability mutation.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin-only page displaying registered users and their availabilities in tables, with delete actions for both, plus a badge management section.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Monthly calendar view showing per-day availability counts as clickable cells, with month navigation and an embedded chat panel below.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple page that renders the full-height group ChatPanel component with a header.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a specific date showing all users' availability entries, allowing the current user to edit or delete their own entry.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Leaderboard page displaying ranked users with win/loss records, allowing the current user to record or remove wins/losses for their available days, with rank-change toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders the user profile page with stats, match history, leaderboard ranks, badges, and a win/loss chart. Includes a `computeBestStreak` helper and a `StreakStats` component showing current and best win streaks.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides utility functions for file handling: converting a File/Blob to Uint8Array, extracting name initials, and validating image file type and size.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Provides utility functions for time input handling, including generating hour/minute/period options, formatting a time string, and parsing a time string into its components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius variables, accordion keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project state for the Somers Scheduler app, recording two pending feature requests: converting a line chart to a bar chart and fixing the best streak calculation to use consecutive wins instead of a cumulative total.
